rationale: Grady brings deep expertise in FDA-regulated AI products and commercializing into government markets (VA, DoD), while Georgi is actively building workflow automation platforms and hiring for GTM execution—two complementary strengths for scaling a regulated health tech startup. Grady's conviction that startups are a creative endeavor where non-engineers can build companies aligns with Georgi's hands-on approach to helping early-stage teams punch above their weight through automation.
intro_message: Grady Hannah, meet Georgi—he's building AI-powered GTM automation for startups and runs hackathons; you bring regulated medtech commercialization expertise and could benefit from the automation playbook he's developed.
